name: Psycho Mystery Series 'Sin -Tsumi-'
original_name: サイコミステリー・シリーズ「Sin -罪-」
source:
When he came to, he found himself collapsed deep in the mountains.
Judging from the business card he was a reporter named Kogami Yato, but he had only a vague memory of where or why he was here.

According to Aida Mamoru, the young man who helped him, they were in the mountains of Aomori, near Karubarikan, a Western-style mansion built by the president of a major corporation. Apparently, a valuable painting was being auctioned at the mansion that day, and the young man had been invited as a history student.
Hoping to find clues to his lost memories, the protagonist decides to visit the mansion with Aida, but...

[Translated from [url=https://info.gmodecorp.com/gmodearchives/psychomystery/sin/]G-Mode official page[/url]]
translation:
当他醒来时，发现自己倒在了大山深处。
从名片上看，他是一名记者，名叫小神夜斗，但他对自己在哪里、为何来到这里只有模糊的记忆。

据帮助他的年轻人相田守说，他们在青森县的山区，靠近轻木馆，这是一座由一家大公司的总裁建造的西式宅邸。显然，那天宅邸里正在拍卖一幅名贵画作，而这位年轻人是以历史系学生的身份被邀请的。
为了寻找自己失去的记忆的线索，主角决定与阿依达一起参观宅邸，但是……
